title: Life Plan Discounts in an Assisted Living Advance Payment
content:
**Life Plan member bulletin — advance payments under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.**

A Larkspur Life Plan member's coming months carry the plan discounts:

- a customer holding an **Entrance Fee Agreement** in occupied status with an **occupancy date at least 60 whole months** before the handling date receives the plan's **rent discount percentage** off the coming months' rent and its **care fee discount percentage** off the care fee they carry;
- an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement of **shorter standing** receives **0.5** of those discounts;
- a customer **without** an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement receives none.

The plan discount is taken off the coming months' rent and care fee only — not off the care add-ons, any insurer direct billing administration fee or the account balance — and the advance is rounded once at the end. A coming month whose care fee is left to a long-term care insurer carries no care fee to discount. The percentages are those of the agreement's plan in the Entrance Fee Agreement terms; whole months run from the occupancy date to the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the occupancy date.

### Illustration (hypothetical plan: rent discount 5 percent, care fee discount 10 percent; one coming month with rent 4285.00 and care fee 1874.00)

| Agreement standing | Plan discount |
|---|---|
| 60 whole months or more | 214.25 plus 187.40, that is 401.65 |
| Under 60 whole months | 0.5 of 401.65, that is 200.825 before the final rounding |
| No occupied agreement | None |
